description: This file contains unit tests for the Http2FrameDecoder class, testing decoding of various HTTP/2 frame types, error conditions, and payload handling.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoderPeer
classes.description: A helper class providing access to private members of Http2FrameDecoder for testing.

classes.name: Http2FrameDecoderTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing Http2FrameDecoder, including methods for decoding, validation, and error simulation.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Begins decoding a frame from the buffer, tracking decode speed and errors.

methods.name: ResumeDecoding
methods.description: Resumes decoding a frame, used for incremental decoding tests.

methods.name: ConfirmDiscardsRemainingPayload
methods.description: Verifies that the decoder correctly discards remaining payload bytes after an error.

methods.name: PrepareDecoder
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with current settings.

methods.name: ResetDecodeSpeedCounters
methods.description: Resets counters tracking fast and slow decoding paths.

methods.name: VerifyCollected
methods.description: Checks that the collected frame parts match expected values.

methods.name: DecodePayloadAndValidateSeveralWays
methods.description: Decodes a payload in multiple ways and validates the result.

methods.name: DecodePayloadAndValidateSeveralWays (overload)
methods.description: Decodes a payload with expected FrameParts.

methods.name: DecodePayloadExpectingError
methods.description: Decodes payload expecting a decode error.

methods.name: DecodePayloadExpectingFrameSizeError
methods.description: Decodes payload expecting a frame size error.
